summary: Lotus Technology Inc. (Nasdaq: LOT) filed a Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, announcing a change in board composition. Chairman Daniel Donghui Li resigned effective May 31, 2026, for personal reasons, and Joe Quan Zhang was appointed as chairman and member of compensation and nominating committees effective June 3, 2026. Zhang is VP and CFO of Geely Holding. No financial terms, advisors, or shareholder vote are involved. The change is effective immediately, part of execution of the 'Focus 2030' strategy. Watch for any further board or strategic shifts as the company executes its growth plan.
